answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil control by bonding each identity to collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities: when k identities coordinate conflicting votes, the penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making mass forgery economically fatal; an oasis offers no refuge, while an anchor and quartz-tagged audit trail preserve attribution.
